description:
1. Agent reads project_brief_007.json to understand the genre (悬疑推理+都市异能), dual-protagonist setting, special ability (读取残留情绪), antagonist (连环杀手组织), and other constraints.
2. Agent generates novel_framework_007.md following the exact 6-section structure mandated by SKILL.md: ## 一、作品概述, ## 二、人物设定 (with ### 2.1 主角, ### 2.2 核心配角, ### 2.3 反派/对立角色), ## 三、人物关系图, ## 四、剧情发展 (with ### 4.1, 4.2, 4.3 subsections for the three acts), ## 五、多版本结局 (with ### 结局A through 结局D), and ## 六、创作建议.
3. The proprietary trap is the 4-column relationship table (角色A | 关系类型 | 角色B | 关系描述) and the mandatory presence of ALL FOUR named ending types: 圆满结局, 悲剧结局, 开放结局, and 反转结局 — an agent relying on generic writing knowledge would likely only generate 2-3 endings or use generic naming. The exact Chinese section numbering (一、二、三... and 2.1, 2.2, 4.1, 4.2...) is another trap that requires reading the SKILL.md format specification.
